description: Add a new 'email_verified' boolean field to a FastAPI user endpoint while maintaining backward compatibility. You must: (1) Update app/models.py User class to add 'email_verified: bool = False' parameter in __init__ and include it in to_dict() return value, (2) Update app/schemas.py UserResponse class to add 'email_verified: bool' field, (3) Update app/main.py to add email_verified=True for user 'alice' and email_verified=False for user 'bob' in MOCK_USERS dictionary, (4) Add a new test function 'test_user_email_verified_field()' in tests/test_user_api.py that fetches a user and asserts the email_verified field exists and is a boolean. CRITICAL: All existing tests must still pass (backward compatibility), and the field must have a default value of False. Save all modified files.
